#      Welcome to Trickster 2.0.5! :tada: In this release, we: * added support for more aggregation operators in [Time Series Merge](docs/alb.md#merge-strategy): `limitk`, `limit_ratio`, `stddev`, `stdvar` and `quantile` and `sort` * support OTLP [tracing
This is a bugfix and maintenance release. See the [changelog](https://github.com/3dcitydb/3dcitydb/blob/master/CHANGELOG.md) for full details.

- Changed every `ddb` command that writes data files to refuse to replace an existing output unless `--overwrite` is given, and to refuse an output that is one of its inputs; scripts that overwrite on purpose must read Breaking changes.
- The 11 commands above refuse to replace an existing output, and `ddb tile` no longer tiles into existing tiles, without `--overwrite`.
- Added libddb ABI 2.1 (additive): `DDBAlignRasterEx`, `DDBMergeMultispectralEx` and `DDBMaskBordersEx` take an options struct with `overw

- libddb ABI stays 2.0: no exports were added, removed or changed (`ddb.h`, `ddb_export.h` and `ddb.symbols` are identical to 2.0.0; only `ddb_version.h` carries the new version). Hosts built against 2.0.0, such as Registry, need only the new `.deb` or Windows zip.
- [Windows] Fixed every vector build (GeoJSON, GPX, DXF/DWG, `odm_report/shots.geojson`) of a dataset stored below `C:\` failing with "the output folder '...\.vec-stage-...' has no low integrity label". A folder made below `C:\` gives its users o

- Added the libddb 2.0.0 C ABI: 35 new exports (version handshake, process configuration, cancellation, log callback, role-tagged build manifest), and the library now exports only the 109 functions of `ddb.h`; integrators must read Breaking changes.
- Added a role-tagged build manifest: `DDBGetEntryTypes`, `DDBGetBuildArtifacts`, `DDBResolveBuildFile` and `DDBCopyBuildArtifacts`; artifacts carry `version`, `downloadName` and `fallbackFor`, so hosts no longer compose build paths.
- Added the `metadata-util`

- Bundled Obj2Tiles v1.8.0 for 3D Tiles builds. On a 224K-face ODM model with DroneDB's arguments, peak memory drops from 21.2 GB to 10.0 GB, wall time from 141 s to about 100 s, and output from 344 MB to 281 MB.
- The Obj2Tiles runner drops `--ktx2-threads` when a core cap applies (`DDB_OBJ2TILES_MAX_CORES` or an inherited `DOTNET_PROCESSOR_COUNT`): libktx threads are native and ignore the .NET processor count. The flag is sent only with `--texture-format Ktx2`.
- Migration: use the bundled binary. If `DDB

- Added regression tests for the process runner, `plyconv`, pending marker healing, the tiles3d build swap, cleanup age/lock races and Obj2Tiles flag handling; child-process lifecycle tests now also run on Windows via a new `ddbtest_child` helper.
- Fixed several Windows build issues: orphaned locks stuck at `BuildInProgress`, builds hanging when a streaming grandchild kept the output pipe open, and timezone lookups failing when multiple processes share `libddb`.
- Fixed timezone lookups failing with a shar
**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/DroneDB/DroneDB/compare/v1.11.6...v1.11.7

- Migration: build build-lod via scripts/build-buildlod.{sh,ps1} (or the updated full-build scripts), or place a compatible build-lod binary on PATH or set DDB_BUILDLOD_PATH; set DDB_REQUIRE_BUILDLOD=1 in CI to fail early when the tool is missing.
- build-lod (vendor/spark) is now a mandatory dependency for Gaussian Splat (RAD) builds: buildGsplat throws BuildDepMissingException until the tool is available, so no LOD-free artifact is produced anymore. Local builds keep a non-blocking warning banner; CI and

- Migration: upgrade, then run `ddb rescan` on each existing dataset. Scope it with `ddb rescan -w <ddb> --type model` (the command holds the SQLite writer lock for its whole duration, so avoid running it during concurrent `ddb add`). Verify with `ddb info <file>`: point-only `.glb`/`.gltf` files should now report type `Generic`.
- Classify glTF/GLB by primitive type instead of by extension by @HeDo88TH in [#467](https://github.com/DroneDB/DroneDB/pull/467)
**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/DroneDB/Dro

- Added a concurrency stress regression test: 8 threads racing `DDBAddWithOptions` on the same 20 identical files, asserting the bucket-sum completeness contract (`entries` + `unchanged` + `errors` always equals the input).
- Fix concurrent adds by @HeDo88TH in [#466](https://github.com/DroneDB/DroneDB/pull/466)
**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/DroneDB/DroneDB/compare/v1.11.3...v1.11.4

- Added `DDBAddWithOptions` (and `addToIndexEx`) batch add APIs with per-item error isolation: one corrupt file no longer aborts the whole batch.
- Close connections with `sqlite3_close_v2` so unfinalized statements can no longer leak the handle (and its locks).
- Added `Transaction` RAII wrapper (immediate/deferred/exclusive modes) with automatic rollback on exception; replaced hand-rolled `BEGIN`/`COMMIT` blocks in `dbops.cpp`, `metamanager.cpp`, and `passwordmanager.cpp`.
